ops.body: Full cold-upgrade blocker chain measured live 2026-07-25 upgrading 12.20.5→12.20.9 (daemonkit 0.20.5 already fixes launchctl-113): (a) new binary vs running old host: current() requires RuntimeBuild==installer Build → 'prior runtime has the wrong generation'; (b) with runtime stopped, AttestInstalled's bridge auto-starts the OLD app's runtime before the quiesce probe → same refusal, deterministically self-defeating (34/40 attempts, zero external resurrections); (c) old-binary self-uninstall: passes health-match, then 'no exact unexpired stop control authority' for raw-bootstrapped daemons; after fresh kickstart arms authority: 'host stop receipt is not exact' because KeepAlive SuccessfulExit=false relaunches after the wire stop so settlement never reads Gone; (d) working remedy: retire ALL state (bootout both agents, pkill all app processes, move app + .daemonkit-deployment + both plists to backup) then first-install from the new Cellar — with state fully absent, old clients refuse instead of resurrecting. Conclusion: the formula post_install upgrade path has never worked against a live host; the upgrade protocol needs the OLD build to quiesce itself (its build matches its runtime) before the new binary installs, or an installer-driven takeover that skips the bridge probe.
